text: Users in the Indy office can't reach the order portal since 9 a.m. VPN connects fine. Other sites are OK. The database team says no changes were made last night.
Nightly EDI 856 batch to the warehouse partner failed with a timeout at 2:14 a.m. Retry at 3:00 a.m. also failed. Partner says their AS2 endpoint is up.
Several employees report being prompted for MFA repeatedly after this morning's password policy change. Some are locked out entirely.
The reporting dashboard loads but every chart shows yesterday's data. The scheduled refresh job shows 'succeeded' in the scheduler.
Customer-facing checkout page returns HTTP 500 for roughly 1 in 10 requests since the 11:30 deployment. Error logs mention a null reference in the tax calculation service.
One user says their second monitor stopped working after a Windows update. Everything else on the laptop is fine.
